LanguageData.Luke_ImplantSalvageSettingsMaxDestroyDes: The chance of wrecking an implant when the surgeon has no medical ability at all. Skill scales the real chance down from here.
LanguageData.Luke_ImplantSalvageSettingsMinDestroyDes: The floor no amount of skill can go below, mirroring vanilla surgery always carrying some risk. Set to 0% to make expert extraction perfectly safe.
LanguageData.Luke_ImplantSalvageSettingsShowChance: Show the intact chance in the right-click menu
LanguageData.Luke_ImplantSalvageSettingsShowMarker: Mark corpses that hold a salvageable implant
LanguageData.Luke_ImplantSalvageSettingsShowMarkerDes: Draws the implant's own icon over any corpse still carrying one, so you can see which bodies are worth a doctor's time without right-clicking each one.
LanguageData.Luke_ImplantTreeDisabledDesc: Tick "allow corpses with implants" above to use this. With it off, this stockpile turns away every implanted body regardless of what is chosen here.
LanguageData.Luke_ImplantTreeRootDesc: Ticks here are about which CORPSES to accept, not about storing loose implants - that is under Items, Body parts. A corpse is accepted if at least one of its implants is ticked, so unticking an implant only skips bodies whose sole salvage is that part; it never turns away a body carrying something you do want.
LanguageData.Luke_ImplantSalvageSettingsPickerHint: Which implants are worth hauling a body for is set per stockpile, not here - select a stockpile or shelf and look under Corpses in its Storage tab.
LanguageData.Luke_ExtractImplantGizmoDesc: Mark implants in this body for extraction. Whichever doctor is free will come and cut them out, the same way skull extraction works - no one is pulled off what they are doing, and drafted pawns are never used.
LanguageData.Luke_ExtractImplantCancelDesc: Clear every implant marked for extraction on this body.
